name: hunter-mcp
description: Hunter.io MCP: domain search, email finder and verifier, enrichment, discovery, leads. 11 tools.

tools.name: account_info
tools.description: Read the Hunter v2 account plan and exact current credit usage.

tools.name: domain_search
tools.description: Search Hunter v2 emails for one domain/company with current filters.

tools.name: email_finder
tools.description: Find and automatically verify the most likely professional email.

tools.name: email_verifier
tools.description: Verify one email address with Hunter v2.

tools.name: email_count
tools.description: Count Hunter email coverage for a domain/company without returning addresses.

tools.name: email_enrichment
tools.description: Enrich a person from an email address or LinkedIn handle.

tools.name: company_enrichment
tools.description: Enrich a company from its domain.

tools.name: combined_enrichment
tools.description: Enrich both a person and their company from one email.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Use Hunter Discover v2 to find companies from structured or natural-language filters.

tools.name: create_lead
tools.description: Create one Hunter lead. This is a single-attempt mutation.

tools.name: list_leads
tools.description: List Hunter leads with current filters.

api_base.title: API base URL
api_base.description: Override the Hunter API base URL

retry_base_ms.title: Retry base delay (ms)
retry_base_ms.description: Base delay in milliseconds for the GET retry backoff
